newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's sugar output slips 29 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's sugar output slips 29 percent.

text.p: The Pakistan Sugar Mills Association said on Thursday sugar production had reached 885,076 tonnes from July 1996 to January 15, 29 percent down from 1.248 million tonnes in the year-ago period.

It gave no reason for the decline in fiscal 1996/97 (July-June), but one dealer said it was because mills had delayed the start of the cane-crushing season until November instead of October to improve yield.
The association said mills expected to produce 2.65 million tonnes in 1996/97, compared to 2.47 million in 1995/96 and 3.0 million in 1994/95. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
